    Class TpMarkdownViewer

    Interactive Markdown viewer component.

    Example

    <tp-markdown-viewer></tp-markdown-viewer>

    Tagname

    tp-markdown-viewer

    Attr

    lite = false - Uses the compact single-example viewer with rendered HTML output.

    Attr

    src = "" - Comma-separated URLs of external Markdown example files.
